existingCanonicalOrder.observation: Canonical validator already establishes total event order from phase array position; separate after edges only point backward.

representation.phaseOrder: explicit array order, no redundant after field
representation.allocation: authored createBefore phase ID, lowered to the preceding boundary
representation.invalidUnrepresentableAllocation: rejected rather than silently clamped to frame entrance
representation.unchanged: all source IDs, state IDs, groups, scopes, reads, updates, actions, parameters, outputs, finite budgets, frame count and disposal choices

initialBoundaryFailure.cause: Original per-frame creation point clamps all earlier positions to frame entrance; fixed prototype rejects every such authored position, not only index zero.

nextGate: Integrate a separately versioned generation/repair grammar without old-policy conflicts; retain originals and all existing validators, then assess fixed real case. Prototype conversion/fixture checks do not prove model output or scientific quality.
